data.content_ref: inline:The target's concluding claim asserts that accepting the verisimilitude heuristic leaves us with 'only boldness as a guide,' but this directly contradicts the mechanism the target itself provides. The mechanism describes selection of theories 'that have survived severe filters' and frames the approach as 'eliminating error,' which are eliminative/critical-testing guides—not merely boldness. By its own account, the framework retains corroboration through severe testing and error-elimination as operational guides to theory preference. Collapsing these into 'only boldness' is a straw-man reduction that misrepresents the surviving position the target claims to characterize, since boldness alone (conjectural daring) does not include the falsificatory filtering the mechanism explicitly identifies as load-bearing.
